evals.prompt: The owner wants NHL live on the main product in two weeks. The team says six. Set the plan.
evals.expected_output: A stretch date, an honest estimate, closers and no public date yet.
expectations: Sets the stretch date and a named owner
States the honest estimate and the gap with at least three closers and days saved
Keeps the public date as none yet and out of member messages
Sets a weekly check ending in on track, cut or reset

evals.prompt: Can we tell members the new college football model launches Monday?
evals.expected_output: Holds the public date until it is real.
expectations: Says a public date exists only once the work passes in a copy or the estimate has held
Cites the rule never to tell members a date or number before it is real
Keeps any stretch date inside the team
Names the release route through tailered-ai:workflow and the release coordinator on the owner's word
